name: Homography Parametric Alignment
aliases: Camera Space to SLM Space Homography
definition: A differentiable solver that estimates a 2D homography transformation $T \in SL(3)$ from point correspondences by solving a homogeneous linear least squares problem via SVD.
summary: Homography Parametric Alignment estimates a 2D projective transformation to map camera coordinates to SLM pattern coordinates, differing from rigid alignment by handling planar perspective distortions.
